The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of 5-ARIs is associated with reduced rates of acute urinary retention, and that this effect is not limited to the initial 6 months of therapy.
patients with BPH who are treated with 5ARIs have a significantly lower risk of acute urinary retention (AUR) and a lower risk of surgery compared with patients not receiving any drug therapy.
the use of 5ARIs and antimuscarinic drugs in the treatment of patients with BOPH is a good strategy to avoid AUR and the subsequent need of surgery.
